question: Which of the following former Chief Economic Advisors has been appointed as the full time member of National Institution for Transforming India (NITI) Aayog in November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arvind Virmani.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Arvind Virmani **served as the **Chief Economic Advisor **from 2007 to 2009.</st
